stop_records.reaction: Selected I am stopping in Feedback; it filled the text box by itself; I typed nothing and did not submit. I stop at 5:41 game time with the storehouse and cabin both done and the storm still four hours off. The storm was never a threat - 180 boards in under two game hours with eight willing people, nobody objected, nobody refused. The two confessions, Nora and her handle and Sam and his false report, were the best writing, but each was a single line I could not answer. I understood everything and had nothing to decide. The want-quit did not pass. I would not leave it running.

It filled the note itself; no typing, Submit, consent change or production note. Later observations were text-only. Exact clean 24eaf9b before and after, tester exit 0, captured PIDs/profile absent and port closed. Target 2026-10-27.
